description: Welcome to this rare opportunity to own a top-floor condo in beautiful Sausalito, offering comfort, style, and an unbeatable location in one of Marin County's most desirable communities. This bright and airy home features an open layout filled with natural light, updated wood-like laminate flooring, and fresh interior paint throughout. The functional galley kitchen provides efficiency and charm, while the private deck showcases peaceful hill viewsan ideal setting to relax and unwind. Residents will appreciate the serene hilltop setting paired with incredible convenience. Located just minutes from beaches, scenic parks, hiking and biking trails, boutique shopping, public transportation, and vibrant downtown Sausalito, this home also offers quick access to Highway 101 and an easy commute to San Francisco. Move-in ready and low-maintenance, this condo blends location, lifestyle, and everyday ease. Opportunities to own in this sought-after area at this price point are truly rare.
